The '''Pika Oasis''' was an oasis located on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], between the [[Mospic High Range/Legends|Mospic High Range]], the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Great Mesra Plateau]] and the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

==Description==
The Pika Oasis was the commercial center of the farming country west of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. It was home to [[Dannar's Claim]], the center of local society in the oasis. Apart from Dannar's Claim, much of the territory on and around the oasis is owned and farmed by the local businessman [[Orrin Gault]].<ref name="Blog-Kenobi" />

==History==
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Nebit's tribe/Legends|Nebit's clan]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|intercepted]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtroopers]] while traveling from Bestine to Pika Oasis. However [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were already sold to the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
